note.summary: Garden turns your Loam activity into a 3D floating island where trees, shrubs, flowers and landmarks grow as you and your agents work. It runs a local server to read activity summaries from Loam and gives your persona agents a tool to suggest specific next steps beside your plants.
touches: Runs a local Python server and an MCP tool for persona agents.
Reads Loam activity summaries (facts) for agents, projects, files, chats, apps, local plugins, installation date and public work.

Through Loam's public-work fact reader, checks api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com using your chosen GitHub login for public Market listings, download totals, issues and merged pull requests; the plugin code itself makes no external network requests.
Reads its own plugin settings and writes growth history and agent ideas to its private server folder.
may_change: Adds the Garden app and an island icon in Apps.
During your first two weeks, can show a dismissible update line in Chats, controlled by a plugin setting.
Gives persona agents a prompt and the garden_idea tool to leave or withdraw one suggested draft per plant kind, which opens in the chat composer only when you tap it.
Caches compact summary counts in plugin settings and temporary draft text in browser sessionStorage.
worth_knowing: Bundled three.js r160 source modules are served locally from assets/three with no external CDN.
Only counts, names, paths and identifiers from Loam's fact summaries are used; chat text and file contents are not read by the island model.
